_note: THE SLOW JOURNEY -- 31 stations, authored as PLACES rather than a track (Ryan 2026-08-20: 'this could be a 20-minute 30-minute video just on this painting... a painting is not something you race through. It's about the journey.'). Each station names a place in MASTER px and two framings: WIDE (stand back and see the scene) and DETAIL (what the push goes in to look at). build-route.py turns these into camera keys using pacing laws -- never faster than the cap, zoom and dolly rate-limited -- so the FILM'S LENGTH EMERGES from the painting instead of being squeezed into a soundtrack. Every station was authored against a gridded crop of the master (evidence/band-*.png), so every detail target is a real thing in the painting. Silent: Ryan's narration is the soundtrack.
_safeRects: Measured on the master 2026-08-20 (evidence/measure-*.png, tile scan in the report): the great collector seal spans x2800-4000/y0-1000, Wang Meng's inscription x4550-6300/y80-1550, a heavy left seal column x0-724/y13300-15860, and two seals in the mist x112-330/y9500-10080. A station whose frame could reach one of those declares its own 'safe' rect to shut it out. Cropping calligraphy or a seal into prominence is banned -- the previous cut opened on a column of them.

stations.name: the-river
stations.why: the film opens on water and stone with nobody in it -- the scroll's own beginning, living ripples, before any figure appears

stations.name: midstream-rocks
stations.why: the boulders standing in the shallows and the tuft of river grass on the right bank

stations.name: the-near-bank
stations.why: the rock shelf the party will walk out onto -- relief plane, the near stone

stations.name: the-ox-and-the-child
stations.why: the ox carrying Ge Hong's small son, led by a servant -- the family's baggage train

stations.name: the-women-of-the-house
stations.why: the women walking behind the ox under the vine-hung trees, the last of the household

stations.name: the-plank-bridge
stations.why: the trestle bridge itself -- the pile of props under the deck, water breaking beneath it

stations.name: ge-hong-and-the-deer
stations.why: THE SUBJECT: Ge Hong crossing with the fan raised, the pack-deer at his shoulder, a porter behind. The deepest push of the lower scroll

stations.name: the-pine-over-the-crossing
stations.why: the pine leaning out over the path where the gust cycle plays -- foliage in motion against still rock

stations.name: the-ledge-above
stations.why: the resting ledge on the left wall where two small figures have stopped -- the climb has begun

stations.name: the-stream-descent
stations.why: the stream coming down out of the gorge over stepped rock

stations.name: the-falls
stations.why: the white fall dropping between the dark cliff walls -- the vertical axis of the whole scroll

stations.name: the-great-pine
stations.why: the old pine spreading over the right-hand shoulder, its trunk drawn in dry brush

stations.name: gorge-narrows
stations.why: both walls turning in at once -- the closest the rock ever comes to the camera

stations.name: the-cliff-nose
stations.why: the great cliff nose under the autumn trees -- the deepest push in the film

stations.name: the-hanging-canopy
stations.why: blue-green and rust canopies hanging off the right wall over empty air

stations.name: the-red-maples
stations.why: the orange maple mass on the left wall -- the one place the painting lets colour run

stations.name: upper-gorge-pines
stations.why: the pines on the far shoulder, already looking down on where we came from

stations.name: the-fenced-path
stations.why: the railed path cut into the rock -- the route the family is taking up

stations.name: the-gully-footbridge
stations.why: the little bridge over the side gully, a traveler on it

stations.name: the-pine-grove
stations.why: the ranked pines below the compound, drawn needle by needle

stations.name: the-second-falls
stations.why: the far cascade on the right wall, thin and white, high above the gorge floor

stations.name: the-approach
stations.why: the path arriving at the fence line, autumn trees around the gate

stations.name: the-lower-hall
stations.why: the thatched lower hall with its open court -- the first roof of the new house

stations.name: the-terrace
stations.why: the stone terrace the halls stand on, cut into the slope

stations.name: the-main-hall
stations.why: the main hall -- the destination of the move to Mount Luofu, a figure in the doorway

stations.name: the-west-pavilion
stations.why: the smaller roof off to the west under its own trees

stations.name: the-rear-court
stations.why: the back of the compound where the roofs give way to the mountain

stations.name: the-rear-pines
stations.why: the dense pine wood behind the house -- the last inhabited place in the painting

stations.name: the-ridge
stations.why: the bare ridge above the treeline, brush getting drier and looser as the air thins

stations.name: the-cloud-gap
stations.why: mist crossing the mountain and cutting the peaks loose from the ground

stations.name: mist-release
stations.why: the release: the camera RISES into the far peaks and pulls BACK (negative dolly, reverse parallax) instead of pushing in -- the journey ends by opening out. Its safe rect climbs through the gap LEFT of the inscription (x<4200) and above the great seal (y>1050), so the peaks are reachable without cropping calligraphy into the frame.
